user.title: Connect to the PS5
user.description: The ps5-hass payload must be running on the console.

data_description.host: IP address or name of the PS5.
data_description.port: Port of the payload (8181 unless changed in config.json).

zeroconf_confirm.title: PS5 found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Set up {name}? The console will show a pairing code on the TV.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The PS5 no longer accepts the stored token. Pair again with a new code from the TV.

pair.title: Enter the code from the TV
pair.description: The PS5 shows "ps5-hass pairing code: …" on the TV. Enter the 6 digits within two minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the payload. Is the console on and the payload loaded?
error.code_expired: The code has expired or is used up. Tick "Show a new code".
error.rate_limited: Please wait {retry_after} seconds before asking for a new code.

abort.already_configured: This PS5 is already set up.
abort.unsupported_api: This payload version is not supported. Update the integration.
abort.locked: Pairing is locked for {minutes} minutes after too many wrong codes.
abort.cannot_show_code: The console cannot show a pairing code (notification or randomness unavailable).
abort.token_limit: All 8 pairing slots of the console are used. Delete config.json on the console to reset them.

data_description.sources: Which titles the media player offers as sources.
data_description.favorites: Each favourite gets its own start button.

console_off.message: The PS5 payload is not reachable (console off, in rest mode or payload not loaded).

auth_failed.message: The PS5 no longer accepts the token. Pair again.

unknown_source.message: There is no app called "{source}" on the PS5.

not_installed.message: This app is not installed on the PS5.

no_user.message: No user is logged in on the PS5.

power_actions_disabled.message: Update the ps5-hass payload to v0.4; permissions are no longer needed.

other_app_running.message: Another app is running on the PS5.

title_mismatch.message: A different app is running on the PS5 by now.

no_app.message: No app is running on the PS5.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests to the PS5. Try again in {retry_after} s.

power_off_disabled.message: Update the ps5-hass payload to v0.4; permissions are no longer needed.

fan_control_disabled.message: Update the ps5-hass payload to v0.4; permissions are no longer needed.

fan_above_stock.message: The PS5 does not allow a threshold above its own factory value.

not_running.message: No game is running on the PS5.
